flags.why: This word has a formal register that the uncommon tag does not convey, as described in the [dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/luan-thuong-eOfC1K2MZxmv7.html).
The entry confuses nhuôm with nhuốm, which means to become tinged with a colour rather than grayish, as shown in the [dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nhu%E1%BB%91m).
flags.fix: Replace with headword nhuốm: verb | to become tinged with a colour; example: Bức tường cũ nhuốm màu xám. = The old wall has taken on a grey tinge.

flags.why: The entry omits the common sense of being badly beaten or defeated, illustrated by thua te tua in [everyday sports commentary](https://vnexpress.net/vong-tron-doc-hai-cua-bong-da-viet-4378589.html).
flags.fix: adj [colloquial] | badly beaten; soundly defeated; example: Đội tôi thua te tua. = Our team suffered a crushing defeat.
